Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		repair: Repair = Repair.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = rid),
		staff: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = sid),
		approval: ApprovalHistory = ApprovalHistory.allInstance()->any(o|o.StaffId = sid and
		o.Suggestion = suggestion and
		o.Reject = reject)
	precondition:
		repair.oclIsUndefined() and
		staff.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		repair.Process>=0 and
		repair.Process<=2 and
		(staff.Role = 1 or

	postcondition:
		let history: ApprovalHistory in

		repair.History->includes(history) and

		else if repair.Process = 1 and
		staff.Role = 2 
		then repair.Process = 2 
		else if repair.Process = 2 and
		staff.Role = 3 
		then repair.Process = 3 
		else if reject 
		then repair.Process = 5 
		else repair.Process 
		endif  
		endif  
		endif  
		endif ) and
		Repair.allInstance()->includes(repair)
}
